en: The image depicts an old street scene with cobblestone roads, several people in early 20th-century attire, and historical buildings. On the left, a building displays the sign 'Zum weissen Ross,' likely an inn or restaurant, with a woman standing below. On the right, a prominent café is visible with 'Café' written twice on ornate signage. Additional text on shopfronts include names such as 'Louis Lisske' and signs for other businesses. The overall tone is sepia, indicating an old photography style. The word 'Elsterwerda' is printed at the top, suggesting the name of the town. The architectural style and text suggest a Central European setting, likely German.
